graph_title: Official Development Assistance for infrastructure (total gross disbursement)
indicator_name: Total official international support (official development assistance plus other official flows) to infrastructure

progress_calculation_options.series: Official Development Assistance for infrastructure (total gross disbursement)

sources.organisation: Basque Agency for Cooperation and Solidarity

indicador_disponible: Official Development Assistance for infrastructure (total gross disbursement)
objetivo_global: 9- Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
meta_global: 9.a Facilitate sustainable and resilient infrastructure development in developing countries through enhanced financial, technological and technical support to African countries, least developed countries, landlocked developing countries and small island developing States
definicion: Official Development Assistance from the regional and local  administrations of the Basque Autonomous Community for insfrastructure (total gross disbursement)
formula:
$$ODA_{insfrastructure}^{t}$$

where: 

$ODA_{insfrastructure}^{t} $= amount of Official Development Assistance for insfrastructure in year $t$
observaciones:
The insfrastructure sector comprises all OECD Creditor Reporting System (CRS) sector
codes in the 210, 220, 230, 231, 232, 233, 234, 235, 236, 240 and 250 series.
justificacion_global:
Total ODA (Official Development Assistance) and OOF (Other Official 
Flows) to developing countries quantify the public effort (excluding 
export credits) that donors provide to developing countries for infrastructure.


Source: United Nations Statistics Division
dato_global: Total official flows for infrastructure, by recipient countries (millions of constant 2022 United States dollars) DC_TOF_INFRAL UNSTATS
comparabilidad: The available indicator complies with the United Nations metadata.

es.indicador_disponible: Official Development Assistance for infrastructure (total gross disbursement)
es.objetivo_global: 9- Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
es.meta_global: 9.a Facilitate sustainable and resilient infrastructure development in developing countries through enhanced financial, technological and technical support to African countries, least developed countries, landlocked developing countries and small island developing States
es.definicion: Ayuda Oficial al Desarrollo de la Administración Autonómica y Local de la CAPV  Asistencia oficial para el desarrollo destinada a infraestructuras (desembolso bruto total)
es.formula:
$$AOD_{infraestructuras}^{t}$$

donde: 

$AOD_{infraestructuras}^{t} $= Cantidad de Ayuda Oficial al Desarrollo destinada a infraestructuras en el año $t$
es.observaciones:
El sector de las infraestructuras comprende todos los códigos sectoriales de las series 210, 220, 230, 231, 232, 233, 
234, 235, 236, 240 y 250 del Creditor Reporting System (CRS) de la OCDE.
es.justificacion_global:
Los flujos totales de Ayuda Oficial para el Desarrollo (AOD) más otras corrientes oficiales de recursos 
a los países en desarrollo cuantifican el esfuerzo 
público (excluidos los créditos a la exportación) que los donantes proporcionan 
a los países en desarrollo para infraestructura.

Fuente: División de Estadísticas de las Naciones Unidas
es.dato_global: Flujos oficiales totales para infraestructura, por países receptores (millones de dólares estadounidenses constantes de 2022) DC_TOF_INFRAL UNSTATS
es.comparabilidad: El indicador disponible cumple con los metadatos del indicador de Naciones Unidas.
